SELECT s.store_id = 999 AS is_999, s.store_id = 900 AS is_web,
  p.category AS cat_at_return, cp.subcategory AS sub_asis,
  (r.return_date = CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', r.return_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS date_matches_helsinki,
  count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) sales_lines, sum(r.quantity_returned) units, sum(r.refund_net) refund_net,
  min(r.quantity_returned) minq
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
  AND (cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture' OR p.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT count(*) lines, sum(r.quantity_returned) units,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL) no_sale,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.return_date < f.sale_date) before_sale,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.quantity_returned > f.quantity) over_qty,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE fp.sku <> p.sku) sku_mismatch,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.quantity_returned <= 0) nonpos,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.staff_purchase_flag) staff,
  string_agg(DISTINCT r.reason_code, ',') reasons,
  min(r.return_date) mind, max(r.return_date) maxd
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
LEFT JOIN dim_product fp ON fp.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'

WITH a AS (
 SELECT sum(r.refund_net) refunds_fact, count(*) n FROM fact_return_line r
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
 WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
b AS (SELECT sum(returns_net) refunds_rpt FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<>999)
SELECT * FROM a, b

SELECT SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_store s     ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p   ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp  ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d      ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
  AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND cp.subcategory = 'Garden Furniture'
